PT covers all five major domains — physical causation, consciousness, ethics, origins, meaning. This alone puts it above 5/10.

- **Physical Causation:** Mechanistically *claimed*, weakly delivered ⚠️ (prehension-physics gap)
- **Temporal Causation / Becoming:** Mechanistically so
